Hi Miranda,

Thanks for applying to the Senior Product Manager role at Redwood Inference — I'm Vanessa on our talent team. We'd love to set up a 30-minute phone screen to learn about your background and share more about the role.

Could you share 3 windows (date + local time) over the next 7–10 days that work for a 30-minute call? We generally run screens between 9:00am–4:30pm PT. If it helps, I'm listing a couple of suggested slots in PT:

- Tue Jan 6, 10:00–10:30am PT

If none of those work, tell me your timezone and a couple of convenient times and I'll send a calendar invite that includes the hiring manager (Karthik) and the interviewer (Dylan).

Please also attach your most recent resume if the one you submitted isn't up to date.

Thanks — look forward to connecting.
